d:
Some locations carry stories of tragedy, disturbing events and unexplained encounters that seem to linger long after the past. In this compilation, the Ghost Adventures crew investigates places where unsettling histories may hold clues to the strange experiences reported there. As they explore each location and search for answers, the first signs of a troubled past begin to emerge. Could these dark histories explain what visitors claim to experience today?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 3, Episodes 3, 12, 10, 6, 4, 11 and 5, on Discovery Channel India.
